metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugin collection with 22 specialized plugins

plugins.name: core-config
plugins.description: Python auto-format + cross-platform notifications. Work guidelines live in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (SSOT).

plugins.name: github-dev
plugins.description: GitHub workflow: commit, PR, issue, worktree, unified CodeRabbit + ChatGPT-Codex cr-fix pipeline v2 (Step 5 pre-flight review detection across CR commit-status + comments + Codex reviews + Codex emoji 3-channel; autonomous Step 9 judgment replaces per-finding AskUserQuestion — LLM judges real/spurious + severity + fix-size and applies/defers/skips with logged reasoning; rate-limit sniffer now covers commit-status description + in-place comment edits; polling interval 60s → 8s; --auto-merge + --skip-minor + --cr-source retained), project tracking, release. create-issue-label promoted to create-issue-labels skill (dual-tool: Claude + Codex)

plugins.name: code-scout
plugins.description: Multi-axis code & ML research harness. 5-axis scout team (github/hf/web/docs/paper) + synthesis-scout + research-orchestrator skill + exa-web-search skill. exa MCP first, WebSearch fallback, firecrawl tier-3, insane-search tier-4 (WAF/blocked URLs). paper-scout wraps paper-search-tools 8-source family. /deep-research is the sibling for non-code/ML topics (code-scout does not delegate).

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Multi-model deliberation: Claude, Codex, Gemini

plugins.name: deepwiki
plugins.description: AI-powered GitHub repo documentation. ask + generate-llmstxt as native skills (dual-tool: Claude + Codex)

plugins.name: notebook
plugins.description: Safe Jupyter notebook editing

plugins.name: ml-toolkit
plugins.description: GPU parallel processing, Gradio CV apps, CV notebook generation, interactive CV data exploration

plugins.name: translator
plugins.description: Web article translation to Korean

plugins.name: midjourney
plugins.description: Midjourney V7 image generation

plugins.name: interview
plugins.description: Structured requirements gathering

plugins.name: notion
plugins.description: Markdown to Notion upload

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Remove AI writing patterns from text

plugins.name: paper-search-tools
plugins.description: Academic paper search (arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, etc.)

plugins.name: docs-forge
plugins.description: README/CHANGELOG generation with CRO best practices

plugins.name: slidev
plugins.description: Slidev markdown presentation generator with interview workflow and KubeCon-level visual enhancement

plugins.name: workflow-viz
plugins.description: System workflow Mermaid diagrams and ASCII progress tracking

plugins.name: rules-forge
plugins.description: CLAUDE.md generation and .claude/rules/ modular structure with auto mode detection (NEW/TIGHTEN/SPLIT/REORGANIZE), single write-rules skill entrypoint

plugins.name: tcrei-prompt
plugins.description: Rewrite prompts using Google's TCREI structure for next-session reuse

plugins.name: codex-bridge
plugins.description: Sync my-claude-plugins skills, commands, and subagents to Codex (~/.agents/skills/ for skills+commands, ~/.codex/agents/*.toml for subagents — USER scope) so they become callable as native $skill-name / subagent. Body-only transform with bridge_source provenance marker.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Karpathy LLM-Wiki 3-layer: 6 skills (query/ingest/lint/bootstrap/migrate/post-merge-wiki) + 3 soft-hint hooks + bootstrap templates. Neutral .llmwiki/ root (codex-bridge .claude/->.codex/ can't fork it); resolves .llmwiki/wiki -> legacy .claude/wiki -> .codex/wiki.

plugins.name: spec-state
plugins.description: Spec/issue/PR work-pipeline aggregate. state-tracker skill manages .claude/state/spec.json (read/init/start/complete). Called by github-dev:post-merge.

plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: One-shot first-day project bootstrap: interview, .claude/ scaffold, minimal CLAUDE.md (LLM-Wiki entrypoint), AGENTS.md with Codex GitHub cloud reviewer guidelines (general/ml/web variants), README/CHANGELOG seed, gh repo create + initial push. Single command /project-init:new.
